summary.ja: Yee FDTDのTMz/TEz、s/p偏光のFresnel界面、Brewster・全反射とPMLを固定入力で検証。
summary.en: Validate Yee TMz/TEz, s/p Fresnel interfaces, Brewster/TIR and PML with fixed inputs.

references.label: Numerical solution of initial boundary value problems involving maxwell's equations in isotropic media (1966)
references.scope: Method-specific source; see the detailed reading for source role and actual review depth.

references.label: Fadime Bekmambetova and Xinyue Zhang and Piero Triverio (2017). A Dissipation Theory for Three-Dimensional FDTD with Application to Stability Analysis and Subgridding
references.scope: Research preprint v2; energy Eq26 and strict CFL Eq35 consulted. Not a claim to implement its subgridding method.

references.label: Jean-Pierre Bérenger (1994). A Perfectly Matched Layer for the Absorption of Electromagnetic Waves
references.scope: Original split-field PML publication: bibliographic identity and abstract checked. Original full text was not available for inspection. The implemented reduction and discrete balance are derived and tested separately; consult Johnson for the matched-layer interpretation.

references.label: Steven G. Johnson (2021). Notes on Perfectly Matched Layers (PMLs)
references.scope: Author notes, selected sections3.4,4.1–4.2 and7.1–7.3: independent x/y coordinate stretches and simultaneous corner damping, matching electric/magnetic rates, anisotropic interpretation, discretization reflections and incidence limitations. Not a complete audit of every PML formulation.

references.label: Markus Zahn (2003). Electromagnetic Field Theory: A Problem Solving Approach
references.scope: Author textbook, selected sections 7-6-1/7-6-2 (printed pp522–524), 7-9-1 (pp538–540), and 7-9-3/7-9-4 (pp541–544): normal/oblique Fresnel amplitudes, Snell and critical angles, evanescent fields, p-polarized Brewster condition and normal-power weighting. Field/sign conventions are adapted explicitly. Not an original Fresnel publication or a full-book audit.

assumptions: Selected lossless nonmagnetic planar-interface single-ky TEz p packets; retained TMz vacuum, s-polarized and PML cases.
units: Dimensionless normalized length, time and fields.
boundary_conditions: New TEz cases: periodic y, distant PEC x caps, no PML; exact single-mode Yee reduction with full-2D equivalence tests. Retained TMz periodic/PEC and x/four-side/corner PML cases.

next_deliverable.ja: 損失・分散媒質、多モード界面とエバネッセント場のPMLを別に検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separately validate loss/dispersion, multimode interfaces and PML for evanescent fields.

limitations.ja: 教育用Yee FDTD。既存TMzの真空・界面・PMLに加え、第5版でTEzのp偏光・Brewster条件・全反射を、指定した単一横モードの波束で検証。一般2次元更新との同値性、連続Fresnel参照、有限窓の反射透過流束・複素振幅・エバネッセント減衰と蓄積、離散保存量・物理収支を区別。一般媒質・多モード・損失分散・3次元の包括的な実証ではない。
limitations.en: Educational Yee FDTD: retained TMz vacuum/interface/PML cases plus r5 TEz p polarization, Brewster condition and TIR for specified single-transverse-mode packets. Full-2D equivalence, continuum Fresnel data, finite-window flux/amplitudes, evanescent decay/storage, discrete invariants and physical budgets have distinct roles. Not blanket validation of general media, multiple modes, loss/dispersion or 3D.

metadata_review.level: Original educational Yee TMz/TEz code: continuum Fresnel checks, exact single-mode/full-2D equivalence, refinement, independent energy/flux budgets and ZIP reruns.

assumptions_ja: 指定した無損失・非磁性平面界面の単一ky TEz p偏光波束。既存TMzの真空・s偏光・PML例も保持。
units_ja: 無次元。長さ・時間・場を規格化。
boundary_conditions_ja: 新TEz例：y周期、遠方PEC x外端、PMLなし。単一モードへ厳密縮約し全2次元更新との同値性を検査。既存TMz周期/PEC・左右x/四辺/角PMLも保持。
run_commands: python -m pytest -q test_fdtd.py test_scattering.py test_corner.py test_oblique.py test_polarization.py
